text:
I fixed seven bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no shell tool in this session, so nothing has been run. I found the bugs by reading the code and the tests.

- `books.py`: `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- `factory.py`: `sample_books` now includes `Emma`, so it returns all three titles.
- `fees.py`: `late_fee` now multiplies days by the daily fee instead of adding them.
- `inventory.py`: `recent(n)` now returns the last `n` events instead of `n+1`, and returns an empty list when `n` is 0 or negative.
- `members.py`: `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5, which matches the lending policy comment and the tests.
- `search.py`: it now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text`. The old import pointed at a module that doesn't exist.

Please run `python3 -m unittest` to confirm everything passes.
